title: 1822CA
description: 1822CA wire walk (the legal-move generator, company acquisitions favoured; 3 players, seed 4) continued at random (seed 11), cut after 1,135 actions. ICR (trains 3, 3, P, LP, G) has no route on the graph; at id 594 it attaches the grain train to its LP (choice 2), which becomes "LP-G". The LP was its last local train, so can_run_route? fails, its Route step is skipped (no run_routes, no detach) and Route#setup drops @grain_train with the name left on: ICR keeps an "LP-G" for the rest of the game. Its crowded_corps memo still counts the LP as an extra train until trains next move; later ICR is offered the pullman ("LP-G+2", id 860) and the grain train again ("LP-GG", id 1132) on it and runs routes with it. Ruby HEAD replays this file with zero divergence (city tokens included). A 2026-11-14 1822CA policy game crashed in this state: Choose.grain ["route:grain", "LP-G", "0"] is not in the layout.
